description: Inputs of the governance bake (unit U15-P): the product's own inputs, each with its basis and its tag (doc: read in a committed document; convention: a stated convention). No output of the engine is written here: the tier, the dates, the opinion and the appetite are computed by riskvalidation.governance. Sources: U15 research addendum D1 to D5, decisions W15-1 to W15-19 of the U15 unit sizing, and W15-18 for C02 and C20.

release.basis: W15-19: governance ships in Contraste 0.15.000, the release that carries these documents

basis.en: W15-13: the date of the newest release heading of CHANGELOG.md when the bake runs; committed, never a wall-clock date, never earlier than a raised date
basis.es: W15-13: la fecha del encabezado de versión más reciente de CHANGELOG.md cuando corre el bake; confirmada, nunca una fecha del reloj, nunca anterior a una fecha de levantamiento

synthetic_inventory.basis: W15-4: the owner is a named role of the synthetic bank per risk area, labelled synthetic; the developer is the producing pipeline module; the validator is riskvalidation at the pinned version; there is no approver and no approval date (SDD non-goal 1)

variant_assignment.basis: W15-15 assigns a variant to the fit whose sources its provenance reads, or to the single models document of the case, through riskvalidation.governance.inventory.assign_variant. Where the engine returns no fit because several fits read the same sources, the bake tries two committed identities in this order: the variant's model records carry the ids of exactly one fit (model-record-ids), then the variant id equals the fit id (variant-id-equals-fit-id). A variant neither rule places stays in the excluded list with the engine's reason. An empty list restores the pure W15-15 rule.
